profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Software Engineer | Cloud & Enterprise Solutions 
I am a results-driven Lead Software Engineer with extensive experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications across diverse cloud and enterprise environments. Backed by deep expertise across the entire .NET ecosystem, modern JavaScript frameworks, and cloud architecture, I bridge the gap between complex technical execution and strategic business goals.
Throughout my career, I’ve led both onshore and offshore engineering teams through all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from initial architectural design and API development to automated CI/CD pipeline deployment.
Core Technical Expertise
Frontend: React, Angular, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery
Backend & APIs: C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET, MCP, MVC, RESTful APIs, WCF, ADO.NET
Databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB
Cloud & DevOps: Azure, AWS, CI/CD Pipelines, Azure Workspaces
Enterprise & CRM: Salesforce (Apex), SharePoint, PHP, Legacy Systems (VB, ASP)
Leadership & Methodology
Team Leadership: Proven track record of mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and driving delivery across cross-functional teams.
Agile Practices: Certified Lean Agile practitioner focused on continuous integration, fast feedback loops, and high-quality deliverables.
Always open to connecting with fellow engineers, tech leaders, and organizations looking to build high-performing engineering teams.
